confirmed_findings: Search and /listings/[id] form the core results/detail engine, with source-access fail-closed behavior on listing detail.
Buy and Rent are both intent hubs that route filtered searches into the single /search engine.
Vendre is a coherent seller hub combining publish, indicative estimate and professional accompaniment around one property dossier.
City and city-intent routes under /immobilier are SEO/context surfaces feeding Search, not independent products.
The public professional profile namespace is a detail namespace, not a duplicate professional hub.
The project namespace is a detail namespace, not a duplicate Neuf index.
Pro analytics and alert inboxes are internal restricted surfaces and /pro/leads is already a retired redirect.
Compagnon and profil-recherche are already legacy aliases of Mon Projet.
Quartiers has a legacy root redirect but still exposes parallel neighborhood detail pages that overlap the canonical immobilier district surface.
Promoteurs is functionally a Pro audience page but still has a top-level canonical URL.
Alerts must not be exposed as an active primary feature until notifications are actually implemented.
Credit, Compare, Favorites, Investir and MRE are secondary decision/user journeys rather than primary navigation pillars.
MRE still references the legacy onboarding entrypoint and should be normalized toward Mon Projet after caller audit.
Accompagnement is a separate support/callback surface and should not be merged conceptually into Mon Projet.
About, How it works, FAQ, Contact, removal rights, terms and privacy belong to institutional/help/legal navigation, not primary product navigation.
Demo and visual-qa namespaces are non-product harnesses and must be excluded from architecture decisions and navigation.
